title: Tesla FSD 15 is Rolling OUT. On Time Promise. HUGE
html:
YES, FSD 15 finally, unsupervised robotaxi everywhere. Getting to 1+ million will rerate the stock. Getting FSD 15 in Q4, promises made, promises kept. @elonmusk @TeslaSI
are on time. Thanks a lot. This is HUGE

Tesla FSD 15 is starting a slow rollout. This is path to fully unsupervised Tesla cars. Along with the cybercabs we can buy and start getting in December for personal robotaxi starting in the Texas and Florida cities. FSD 15 is a step change to get very close to robotaxi grade FSD. If this one or the next updates get us all of the way to unsupervised you are a passenger in your Tesla in about Q2 my expectation. 83 cities testing cybercab. Tesla stock rerates when they get to 10,000 and then at 100,000 robotaxi and to millions of cars. Already at almost 2000 unsupervised tesla robotaxi in Texas and Florida. Adding hundreds of cybercabs to Austin, dallas and soon the other 6 cities and then fast rollouts to 70+ cities. All of Texas, All of Florida, Nevada Vegas, Arizona. then the rest. Mid 2027 unsupervised in California. Remove human drivers from 1000 Tesla robotaxi now and let regular California Tesla FSD owners use unsupervised.

HOLY CRAP, the new FSD visualizations in FSD V15 look incredible!

It’s called Tesla Reality View. Legit game-changer. https://t.co/9nckOjks6B
